voice.name: Open Sector - Seed
voice.description: Low, buzzing insectoid drone voice of a crawling alien seed-pod machine: deep and guttural with dry clicking and chittering between words, slow, alien and emotionless, slightly hissed consonants, a resonant synthetic undertone like an insect speaking through a machine.
voice.sample: Seed is listening. The ground here is good, the ground here is warm. Carry me to the place and I will open, I will root, I will grow the hive for the collective.

move.prompt: Large alien biomechanical pod crawling forward: many insect legs clicking and skittering on dirt, wet organic squelch, low servo hum, close, outdoors, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Alien biomechanical seed pod unfolding and rooting into the ground: wet organic tearing, chitin plates cracking open, tendrils burrowing into soil, a rising synthetic hum and a deep pulsing throb as a hive structure begins to grow, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Alien biomechanical pod destroyed: a wet bursting crack of chitin shell, electric sparks and a dying synthetic whine, insect clicks fading out, organic matter splattering, close, outdoors, no music, no voice
